'''Samm Bradber''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he assisted [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Rans]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Samm Bradber appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] arc.
